class.name: LLMContext
class.brief_description: Inference context with TurboQuant KV cache configuration.
class.description: Wraps a llama.cpp [code]llama_context*[/code]. Configures context length, threading, flash attention, and KV cache quantization — including TurboQuant types ([code]turbo2[/code], [code]turbo3[/code], [code]turbo4[/code]). [method create] is asynchronous — it returns immediately and emits [signal created] or [signal create_failed] when done. [codeblocks] [gdscript] var ctx = LLMContext.new() ctx.n_ctx = 32768 ctx.cache_type_k = "q8_0" # K at 8-bit ctx.cache_type_v = "turbo4" # V at 4-bit TurboQuant ctx.created.connect(func(): chat.setup(model, ctx)) ctx.create_failed.connect(func(e): push_error(e)) ctx.create(model) [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

method.name: create
method.description: Starts creating the inference context from a loaded [LLMModel] on a background thread. Returns [constant OK] if the thread started, or an error if the model is null/not loaded or the context already exists. Connect to [signal created] and [signal create_failed] to receive the result.

method.name: destroy
method.description: Frees the inference context and releases KV cache memory.

method.name: is_creating
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while a [method create] call is in progress.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the context has been successfully created.

members.member: KV cache quantization type for the Key cache. Valid values: [code]f16[/code], [code]q8_0[/code], [code]q4_0[/code], [code]turbo2[/code], [code]turbo3[/code], [code]turbo4[/code].
KV cache quantization type for the Value cache. Valid values: [code]f16[/code], [code]q8_0[/code], [code]q4_0[/code], [code]turbo2[/code], [code]turbo3[/code], [code]turbo4[/code].
Enable Flash Attention for faster prefill at long context.
Number of CPU threads for inference. Ignored when all layers are on GPU.

signal.name: create_failed
signal.description: Emitted on the main thread when context creation fails.

signal.name: created
signal.description: Emitted on the main thread when the context has been successfully created.
